rows.en:
{C:81933001}{C:81958296612E00000000}What are you thinking about,
Binzvanker?

{C:81930D00}{C:81958296632E00000000}I'm thinking about where humanity ought to end up...

{C:81933001}{C:81958296642E00000000}Really...? It doesn't look that way to me.
You're plotting to get Le Caine
to do something, aren't you?

{C:81930D00}{C:81958296652E00000000}I'm not plotting anything.
Whatever your son may do
is no concern of mine.

{C:81933001}{C:81958296662E00000000}(Whether you're made to dance to another's tune
　will decide who wins,
　Le Caine...)



{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296672E00000000}What's that strange noise!?

{C:81935500}{C:81958296682E00000000}Aaah, aaah, can you hear meee?
This is Mirawoo Kyao.

{C:81935300}{C:81958296692E00000000}Kyao!
What's happening over there!?
Is everyone safe!?

{C:81935500}{C:819582966A2E00000000}I guess it's no good. I can't hear a thing.
If you can hear me, tell Daba...

{C:819582966B2E00000000}Tell him to come straight to {C:819782830300}Trydetol{C:819782830000}.
Tell him to come here.
Trydetol. I'm counting on you.

{C:81935300}{C:819582966C2E00000000}Kyao!
Use the right frequency!

{C:81935500}{C:819582966D2E00000000}Be careful.
{C:819782830400}Gon Jem{C:819782830000}...


{x00}

What on earth does he mean?
Do you know, Daba?

{C:81935300}{C:819582966F2E00000000}I don't know.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296702E00000000}It looks like we'd better
hurry to Pentagona.
Rie, I'm counting on you.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296712E00000000}Yes. Astante II
is heading for Pentagona at maximum battle speed.

like much.

{C:81958296762E00000000}Well, I've been paid plenty.
If it's an easy job, that's fine by me.


{x00}

{C:81905500}{C:81958296792E00000000}Welcome baaack, Daba.
I've got something good,
so I've been waiting for you.

{C:81905300}{C:819582967A2E00000000}Something good?
What is it, Kyao?

{C:81905500}{C:819582967B2E00000000}Well, come this way.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967C2E00000000}I think I'll tag along, too.

{C:819782830400}Amonduul{C:819782830000} from the enemy while waiting for you, Daba, and rebuilt it into 
{C:819782830400}L-Gaim Mk-II{C:819782830000}!!

{C:819582967E2E00000000}Its performance is better than L-Gaim's,
so put it to good use.

{C:81935500}{C:81958296852E00000000}Rose came by
while I was servicing Mk-II.

{C:81935502}{C:81958296862E00000000}That's right. Kyao's voice
sounds just like
someone I know.

{C:81935500}{C:81958296872E00000000}So we hit it off,
and we've been together ever since.

{C:81958296882E00000000}But Posaydal's army
has been getting more active,
so we thought we'd join you.

are getting more active.

{C:81905700}{C:819582968C2E00000000}We'd better be careful.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D2E00000000}I'll let everyone

{C:81900900}{C:819582960A0100000000}Oh, where have you been?
Apparently, someone called Semuge
sent us a transmission.

{C:819582960B0100000000}Hadn't you better
go up to the bridge?

{C:81930100}{C:819582968E2E00000000}I will.
It sounds like Posaydal's forces are more active,

{x00}

{C:81900600}{C:819582968F2E00000000}Where have you been?
We've had a transmission.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296902E00000000}A new machine and new allies have joined us.
I couldn't help it, could I?

{C:81900600}{C:81958296912E00000000}Then it couldn't be helped.
Nelfea, tell him
what the message said.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296922E00000000}Yes.
The message was from Semuge. He wants us at 
{C:819782830300}Mizun{C:819782830000}.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296932E00000000}From Semuge?
Did he say anything else?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296942E00000000}It looks like more new allies
will be joining us.
He didn't give any details, though.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296962E00000000}Could you head for Mizun?
There are things I need
to discuss there, too.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296972E00000000}Understood, Daba.
We're heading for Mizun.




{x00}

{C:81930D00}{C:81958296982E00000000}You're making the adjustments yourself.
Do you distrust people that much...?

{C:81936F00}{C:81958296992E00000000}Say what you like.
The system you brought me
is too advanced for anyone else to handle.

{C:819582969A2E00000000}I suffered a defeat I never wanted
in the last battle because of that.

{C:81930D00}{C:819582969C2E00000000}Then I'll look forward
to this battle.



{x00}

{C:81930700}{C:819582969D2E00000000}Something that looks like a very powerful barrier
has been erected all around.

{C:81930A00}{C:819582969E2E00000000}Can't you do something
with your skills?

{C:81930700}{C:819582969F2E00000000}Even if we were to hack
Posaydal's systems,
we don't have enough people.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296A02E00000000}You, Nelfea,
and one more person, you mean?

{C:81930700}{C:81958296A12E00000000}You're sharp as ever, Akatsuki.
That's right.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A22E00000000}We need one more person
who's good at that sort of thing.

{C:81930700}{C:81958296A32E00000000}That's right.
For now, all we can do is wait and see.




{x00}

{C:81935102}{C:819582960C0100000000}This time I'll beat them for sure!
But first...
{C:819782830400}Light{C:819782830000}, open a communications channel!

{C:81935302}{C:81958296A42E00000000}What are you planning, Kaine?

{C:81935102}{C:819582960D0100000000}I'm going to declare war.
I'll tell them I'm about to blow them away.

{C:81935202}{C:81958296A52E00000000}You could just fight them...

{C:81935102}{C:819582960E0100000000}Shaddup!
Hurry up, {C:819782830400}Light{C:819782830000}!

{C:81935302}{C:81958296A62E00000000}Yeah, yeah.
...The channel's open.

{C:81935102}{C:819582960F0100000000}Can you hear me, Astante II!?
I'm about to beat the hell out of you.
You'd better be ready!!

{x00}

{C:81930700}{C:81958296A72E00000000}What is this vulgar transmission?

{C:81938700}{C:81958296A82E00000000}{C:819782830400}Musai{C:819782830000} is the source of the transmission.

{C:81935502}{C:81958296A92E00000000}Hey, that voice just now...

{C:81930700}{C:81958296AA2E00000000}Is it someone you know?

{C:81935402}{C:81958296AB2E00000000}Yes, I'm almost certain of it.

{C:81935502}{C:81958296AC2E00000000}I'll borrow the mic.

{C:81958296AD2E00000000}Heeey, Kaine!
We're aboard this ship.
Attack it and I won't let you get away with it!

{x00}

{x00}

What are you going to do, Kaine?

{C:81935102}{C:81958296110100000000}What am I going to do?

{x00}

We're going to land at {C:819782830300}Mizun{C:819782830000}.
Please follow us as well.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81935102}{C:81958296120100000000}What does he mean,
'Please follow us as well'!?
What a damn show-off!

{C:81935202}{C:81958296B22E00000000}Then what are you going to do?
You're not going to follow them?
Even with Rose and Linda aboard!?

{C:81935102}{C:81958296130100000000}I'll follow them.
I've got no choice, have I?
Damn, this pisses me off.

{C:81935302}{C:81958296B32E00000000}Then just follow them without fussing.
Honestly.





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81905102}{C:81958296150100000000}Linda!
Why were you on that ship?

{C:81958296170100000000}We attacked after hearing
what your brother told us.
Not that we wanted to obey his orders.

{C:81905402}{C:81958296B52E00000000}The people on this ship aren't bad.
I could tell just from talking to them a little.

{C:81958296B72E00000000}Please, Kaine.
Lend these people your strength.

{C:81905102}{C:81958296180100000000}It's not that simple...
Right, Tap?

{C:81905202}{C:81958296B82E00000000}Hey, that's dirty.
Don't dump this on me.

{C:81905502}{C:81958296B92E00000000}I'm asking you, too.
There are plenty of other bad people out there.
Please help these people.

{C:81905302}{C:81958296BA2E00000000}When two princesses ask you,
how can you refuse to help?

{C:81905102}{C:81958296190100000000}But...

{C:81905402}{C:81958296BB2E00000000}You won't listen even when I ask?
Fine, then.
As for you and me, Kaine...

{C:81905102}{C:819582961A0100000000}All right, all right! I'll help!
So, please, please,
don't be mad, Linda, pleeease!

{C:81905402}{C:81958296BC2E00000000}Hee hee hee... I was only kidding.
Thank you, Kaine.


{x00}

{C:81905800}{C:81958296BE2E00000000}I've been waiting for you, Daba.
Let me introduce our new allies.

{C:81903302}{C:81958296BF2E00000000}{C:819782830400}Yuu Tagami{C:819782830000} is my name.
These are {C:819782830400}Doris Wave,{C:819782830000}
{C:819782830400}Skipper{C:819782830000} and {C:819782830400}Manon{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C02E00000000}{C:819782830400}Skipper{C:819782830000}?

{C:81903902}{C:81958296C12E00000000}That's what people call me.
You can call me that, too.

{C:81904102}{C:81958296C22E00000000}I have no wish to fight,
but I understand that in this situation,
it can't be helped.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81905800}{C:81958296C32E00000000}They should be a great help to us.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C42E00000000}I'm looking forward to working with you.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296C52E00000000}Now that everyone's here,
there's something I'd like to say.

{C:81905600}{C:81958296C62E00000000}What's this, all of a sudden?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296C72E00000000}Sho, do you remember
what we talked about on Crescent?

{C:81901A00}{C:819582961D0100000000}You mean when Jojo revealed
that he was a prince?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296C82E00000000}Yes. There's something
I want to tell everyone, too.

{C:81958296C92E00000000}I'm a survivor of the Yaman dynasty,
which Posaydal's army destroyed.

{C:81901A00}{C:819582961E0100000000}You were a prince, too, Daba!?
No, I suppose in this case you're a king.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296CA2E00000000}I only wanted to be honest with you.
It doesn't make me
any different from who I've always been.

{C:81905800}{C:81958296CB2E00000000}If you're of the Yaman royal family,
there should be a ceremony.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296CC2E00000000}It's not a ceremony.
It's an expression of gratitude to the earth.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296CD2E00000000}Can you do it, Daba?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296CE2E00000000}Of course... Let's go outside.





{x00}

{C:81905800}{C:81958296D02E00000000}I recognize you as one of the Yaman family.
You are the leader of the rebels!

{C:81905600}{C:81958296D22E00000000}Daba... was a prince all along.
Should I be happy or sad...?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296D32E00000000}Thanks to you all, I found the courage to say it.
Thank you.

{C:81901A00}{C:819582961F0100000000}Come on.
I didn't say a thing.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296D42E00000000}It's the same for me.
I could say it because someone
gave me a push... right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D52E00000000}Whoa, don't turn this on me.
I haven't done anything, either.

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296D62E00000000}You've done plenty.
Whatever happens,
you'll still be the same, won't you?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296D72E00000000}That puts everyone at ease.

{C:8190CF01}{C:81958296DA2E00000000}You accepted us without a fuss.

{C:8190ED01}{C:81958296DB2E00000000}You even accepted me,
though I was your enemy.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DC2E00000000}Ah, please stop!
I just did what came naturally,
without making anything of it.

{C:81958296DD2E00000000}I haven't done anything special!!

{C:8190A102}{C:81958296DE2E00000000}Isn't that what's good about you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DF2E00000000}You're killing me with praise!




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296E02E00000000}Haaah...
What's with everyone?

{C:81900200}{C:819582969D2B00000000}Um...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E32E00000000}Oh, it's you, Lun.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296E52E00000000}'Oh, it's you'? That's not very nice.
I went to all the trouble of following you.
Why did you run away?


{C:81930100}{C:81958296E62E00000000}Even you're teasing me, Lun?

{C:81900200}{C:81958296E82E00000000}I'm not teasing you.
I'm just happy
that everyone likes you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E92E00000000}Everyone likes me, huh?
It doesn't feel real.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296EA2E00000000}That's fine.
Everyone likes you just as you are.
If you just stay yourself...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EB2E00000000}I will.
It's not as if I could change now, anyway.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296EC2E00000000}Shall we go back, then?



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900200}{C:81958296EE2E00000000}As expected, everyone's gone.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EF2E00000000}It's better that way...

{C:81909E02}{C:81958296F02E00000000}What are you sneaking around for?
Everyone's back
aboard Astante II.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F12E00000000}Van,
were you waiting for me?

{C:81909E02}{C:81958296F22E00000000}Yeah.
Have you calmed down a little?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F32E00000000}Yeah, more or less.

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296200100000000}You don't need to worry about it.
Just be yourself.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296F42E00000000}See?
It's just like I told you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F52E00000000}You're right.
I'll keep going at my own pace, as always.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296F62E00000000}Meooow.

{C:81900700}{C:81958296F72E00000000}You're back at just the right time.
Do you know this child?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F82E00000000}No. Who is it?

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296F92E00000000}{C:819782830400}Ed{C:819782830000} is Ed, you knooow.
But that's not my real name.

{C:81900700}{C:81958296FA2E00000000}Apparently, the child stowed away from Brave.
Even the security checks
didn't pick anything up.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FB2E00000000}Then,
how did you find the child?

{C:81900700}{C:81958296FD2E00000000}The Defense Class kids found this child
sneaking food in the dining hall.
We finally caught our stowaway.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FE2E00000000}Hey, young man,
how did you get aboard?

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296FF2E00000000}Eheh heh heh heh heh.
Liiike this.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900700}{C:81958296002F00000000}Rie!
What on earth happened!?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296012F00000000}I don't know!
Astante II
suddenly started up.

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296022F00000000}Can I go ahead and fly it?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296032F00000000}So you're the one who caused this!?

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296042F00000000}I failed back at Brave,
but now I can go vrooom and whooosh
and fly it!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296052F00000000}Aaah, stop, stop!
Don't fly it!

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296062F00000000}Then, saaay,
will you let Ed
ride on Astante II, too?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296072F00000000}I'll let you aboard,
so stop it already!

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296082F00000000}Yeeeeeeeeees!


{x00}

{C:81900700}{C:81958296092F00000000}Ha ha ha ha ha!
He's an interesting boy.

{C:8190CD02}{C:819582960A2F00000000}Well then, once again,
hellooo!

{C:819582960B2F00000000}I'm Edward Wong Hau Pepelu
Tivrusky IV!
I named myself!

{C:81930100}{C:819582960C2F00000000}Edward... what?

{C:8190CD02}{C:819582960D2F00000000}It's too much trouble. Just call me Ed.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582960E2F00000000}(Then don't give yourself
　such a long name...)

{C:819582960F2F00000000}Anyway, welcome aboard, Ed.
But don't ever do that again.

{C:8190CD02}{C:81958296102F00000000}Roger-roger, I'm a monster!
Roar, roar!

{C:81900900}{C:81958296210100000000}Oh, what's all the commotion?

{C:81900700}{C:81958296112F00000000}Oh, Tail.
We've got a brilliant hacker on our side.

{C:81900900}{C:81958296220100000000}Oh, a girl hacker.
Nice to meet you, Ed.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296122F00000000}Oh, a giiirl!!

{C:8190CD02}{C:81958296132F00000000}Eheh heh heh heh heh.


{C:81905300}{C:81958296142F00000000}I heard.
We can't get into Gastogal, can we?
Isn't there some way?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296152F00000000}We need one more person
as skilled as the Professor...
Oh! We've got one!!

{C:81905300}{C:81958296162F00000000}W-what's the matter!?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296172F00000000}Ed!

{C:8190CD02}{C:81958296182F00000000}Meooow?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296192F00000000}Could you give us a hand?
We need your skills.

{C:81900700}{C:819582961A2F00000000}Of course! With her help,
we can get into Gastogal!
Let's launch Astante II.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961B2F00000000}Yes, Professor!




{x00}

{C:81936E00}{C:81958296232F00000000}How long do you intend
to keep this up?

{C:81958296252F00000000}Please stop
involving yourself with that man.

{C:81936F00}{C:81958296262F00000000}You're persistent!
I'm merely using that man.

{C:81937C00}{C:81958296272F00000000}Reporting!
The Gon Jem Squad has been defeated.

{C:81936F00}{C:81958296292F00000000}So in the end, I can rely only on myself.

{C:81935300}{C:819582962E2F00000000}Why isn't he
taking any damage!?

{C:8193CD02}{C:819582962F2F00000000}Well, it's Bio Relation.
Apparently, as long as it's there,
Amandra is invincible.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296302F00000000}Ed, do you know
how to cut it off?

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296312F00000000}Come out, come out,
Bio Relatiooon!

{C:81958296322F00000000}Oops, from here,
there's nothing I can dooo.

{C:81936E00}{C:81958296372F00000000}The times are no longer in your hands.

rows.en:
{C:81905300}{C:819582963B2F00000000}Is it over...?

{C:81905400}{C:819582963C2F00000000}It's over, Dabaaa!!

{C:81905300}{C:819582963D2F00000000}Now, peace for Pentagona, too...
No, it's not over.

{C:81905600}{C:819582963E2F00000000}What are you saying?
Amandra has fallen.
It's over, isn't it?

{C:81905700}{C:819582963F2F00000000}Daba, don't tell me you're...!?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296402F00000000}Now that Pentagona
is finally at peace,
if you wanted to get off here...

{C:81905300}{C:81958296412F00000000}Don't say that.
We're friends, after all.
I'll stay with you to the very end.

{C:81905500}{C:81958296432F00000000}It can't be helped.
This time I'm coming along, too.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296442F00000000}Let's head for the next continent.
Which continent is next?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296452F00000000}Um, the way toward {C:819782830300}Byston Well{C:819782830000} is
open.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296230100000000}Byston Well, huh?
I wonder if Nie and the others are all right.

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296462F00000000}It's Nie and the others we're talking about.
I'm sure they're all right.
Rie, would you set off?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296482F00000000}Yes! Astante II
is launching
for Byston Well!!




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930D00}{C:819582964B2F00000000}I'm settling this with nothing more than exile
for you, a man who killed his father.
You should be grateful, Le Caine.

{C:81932B01}{C:819582964C2F00000000}That's absurd! Father
should still have been alive then.

{C:81930D00}{C:819582964D2F00000000}Who knows?
That's no concern of mine.
The result is all that matters.

{C:819582964E2F00000000}Now leave this land, Le Caine.
Grados has no need of you.

{C:81932B01}{C:819582964F2F00000000}Ghh... Binzvanker.
I'll let you keep your life
until I return.

{C:81958296502F00000000}I will return! I definitely will!!



{x00}
